name: 7 Sided Cube Real SEO
author: 7sidedcube

sections.description:
Important: SEO plugins do not rank websites. Most SEO plugins help you set a technical baseline. Rankings come from strategy, content, and authority built over time. After any plugin, the real SEO work begins.

This plugin provides:
* A lightweight baseline checklist inside WordPress admin
* Plain language explanations and next steps
* An optional request for human help (sends an email to 7 Sided Cube)

License

GPLv2 or later
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to “7 Sided Cube Real SEO” in the admin menu.
  4. Run the baseline check.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin rank my site?

No. It helps you set a technical baseline and spot common issues. Rankings come from strategy, content, and authority built over time.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Baseline checklist, overview content, and request help form.
